observations: This checklist encodes REUSABLE test conditions for the user goal 'place a personalized order as a guest buyer', not a one-off test case for a ticket.
Every check traces to >=1 kb_id from candidate/product-kb.json via FEAT-ORDER-01's feature profile. No check asserts an expected_result without a corresponding oracle source.

Because this is a ZERO_DOC_BOOTSTRAP run, almost all checks are oracle_strength BASELINE (OBSERVED_CURRENT) — a deviation on re-run means 'investigate', not 'confirmed bug'. This is the correct, expected shape for a first-pass checklist, not a gap in this agent's work.

CHK-006-ORDER01 preserves KB-CONFLICT-001 exactly as UNRESOLVED per contract Sec.8: it is written as a monitoring/regression condition for a known-flaky sync path, not as an assertion that sync is broken or fixed.

KB-006 and KB-009 are knowledge_kind INFERRED (no raw evidence_ref) in the upstream KB — per this agent's oracle table, INFERRED does not qualify as CONFIRMED_EXPECTED or OBSERVED_CURRENT, so any check resting only on them is oracle_strength NONE and forced to NEEDS_CONFIRMATION (CHK-013-ORDER01, CHK-017-ORDER01), never upgraded to a real assertion.
unknowns: Whether declined/gateway-failure test-card checkout, missing-required-field submission, exact-boundary text length, Express shipping completion, signed-in buyer checkout, and cart persistence after reload behave as any particular way — none were observed in this run; see each NEEDS_CONFIRMATION check's open_question.
Whether the storefront->portal order sync is durably fixed or was a one-off success (KB-CONFLICT-001) — CHK-006-ORDER01 exists specifically to keep re-checking this, not to declare it resolved.
conflicts: KB-CONFLICT-001 (order JTEL87JY0 never synced to portal; root cause/fix claim unverified) — see CHK-006-ORDER01

checks.title: Product page loads with correct default variant, price, and empty personalization template

applicability.state: product page loaded, before any personalization selected
applicability.theme_or_device: not verified across themes/devices; single desktop browser session only

checks.precondition: Navigate to the storefront product page for campaign 'QA Explore Campaign PB 01' without selecting any personalization option.
steps: Open the product page for the target campaign as a guest (no login).
Observe the pre-selected variant label and displayed price.
Observe the personalize-template field's default state.
checks.observation_point: Variant selector value, price display, personalize-template field value on initial page load.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: variant 'Vertical Framed Poster/Black/12"x18"' pre-selected, price $55.99 shown, personalize template field empty with no default value. A deviation from this on re-run should be treated as a signal to investigate, not an automatic confirmed bug (oracle_strength BASELINE).

checks.title: Selecting a personalize template reveals the correct dependent field set
checks.precondition: On the product page for this campaign, no template selected yet.
steps: Select personalize template value '2' (Poster - Woman and dog clipart).
Observe which additional form fields appear.
checks.observation_point: Set and order of dependent fields rendered after template selection.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: 7 dependent fields appear (Skin Tone auto-default, 2-level Hairstyle, Woman Name text max 10 chars, Cat Breed #1/#2 2-level, Cat Name #1/#2 text max 10 chars). Corroborated once on a different store (observed_count 2, confidence MEDIUM) — still treat any change here as investigation-worthy, not a confirmed regression, since no spec confirms this is the required field set.

checks.title: Personalization fields accept input with live character counters and live mockup preview update

applicability.state: all required personalization fields being filled

steps: Fill Hairstyle=Black, Woman Name (<=10 chars), 2 cat breeds, 2 cat names (<=10 chars each).
Observe character counters next to text fields while typing.
Observe the on-page mockup preview after each field is filled.
checks.observation_point: Character counter values; mockup preview image content.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: fields accept the values entered, counters update accurately (e.g. 9/10, 8/10), and the mockup preview visually reflects the selections. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Add to cart produces exactly one correct cart line item

applicability.state: personalization fields filled -> Add to cart clicked

checks.precondition: All required personalization fields filled for template 2.
steps: Click 'Add to cart'.
Open /cart.
Inspect the resulting line item(s).
checks.observation_point: Number of cart line items; campaign name, variant text (Color/Size), price, quantity, mockup thumbnail on the line item.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: exactly 1 line item, campaign + variant text correct, price $55.99, quantity 1, subtotal $55.99, personalized mockup thumbnail present. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Cart/checkout represent personalization via mockup image only, not as readable field=value text
checks.precondition: Personalized item is in the cart.
steps: Open /cart and the subsequent checkout page.
Inspect the line item's visible properties/text.
checks.observation_point: Presence/absence of readable personalization field=value text (e.g. 'Woman Name: ...') next to the mockup image.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: only mockup image + standard variant text (Color/Size) are shown to the buyer; no field=value list is displayed. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug. Corroborated once on a different store (observed_count 2, MEDIUM).

checks.title: Order appears in portal Orders list within a reasonable time after storefront checkout completes (known-flaky area, KB-CONFLICT-001)

applicability.role: GUEST buyer (storefront) / owner sub=273 (portal verification side)
applicability.state: checkout completed and confirmed on storefront

checks.precondition: Complete a full guest checkout with the Test Payment Gateway (approved card) through storefront to /thank-you.
steps: Note the Shopify order confirmation code and timestamp from /thank-you.
Poll portal Orders list (GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1, TIB Status=Any, Store=Any, date range covering today) repeatedly over at least 90 minutes.
Record whether/when the order appears, and under which store/status filter.
checks.observation_point: Presence and appearance latency of the new order in GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1 / portal Orders list UI.
checks.expected_result: NOT ESTABLISHED as a confirmed SLA. This is a KNOWN-FLAKY / known-issue area, not assumed fixed: one prior order (JTEL87JY0) never appeared across 90+ minutes / all statuses / both stores / 30-day range (KB-CONFLICT-001, still UNRESOLVED); a second order did appear same-session after an unverified user claim of a webhook-config fix (KB-011). Do NOT treat non-appearance as an automatically-new bug and do NOT treat appearance as proof the underlying issue is fixed — either outcome must be logged against KB-CONFLICT-001 for orchestrator/context-quality-reviewer follow-up.
checks.open_question: What is a confirmed/acceptable threshold for 'reasonable sync time', and has the claimed webhook-config root cause fix been independently verified by dev/infra (not just the user's statement)? Until PO/Dev confirm, this check can only report observations, not pass/fail against a real SLA.

checks.title: No per-option pricing surcharge for the tested template/personalization combination

applicability.state: personalization filled (template 2, British fold x2, Black hairstyle) -> before checkout

checks.precondition: Template 2 selected with British fold x2 / Black hairstyle option combination.
steps: Fill personalization with this exact option combination.
Observe subtotal/price before proceeding to checkout.
checks.observation_point: Subtotal value relative to base variant price.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: subtotal remains $55.99 (base variant price), no separate surcharge line for these options. This is scoped strictly to this exact template/option combination (observed_count 2, MEDIUM) — must NOT be generalized into a rule for other templates/options. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Checkout displays Test Payment Gateway alongside real gateway(s) with documented test-card behavior

applicability.state: on checkout page, before entering payment info

checks.precondition: Item in cart, proceeded to Shopify-hosted checkout.
steps: Reach the Payment section of checkout.
Observe the listed payment provider(s) and any test-card instructions shown.
checks.observation_point: Presence of 'Test Payment Gateway' option and its stated card-digit behavior (1=approved, 2=declined, 3=gateway failure).
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: 'Test Payment Gateway' is present alongside other gateway option(s), with the stated card-digit meanings shown. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Selecting Standard shipping computes the expected order total for a US/NY address

applicability.state: checkout, Standard shipping selected, US/NY address

checks.precondition: Cart subtotal $55.99, shipping address in US/NY.
steps: Select 'Standard' shipping method ($8.00).
Proceed and observe the cost breakdown before/at payment.
checks.observation_point: Subtotal, shipping line, tax line (if any), total.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: Subtotal $55.99 + Shipping $8.00 = Total $63.99, no separate tax line for this specific US/NY address. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug; do not generalize the 'no tax line' finding to other addresses.

checks.title: Order confirmation page renders all expected sections after an approved test payment

applicability.state: payment submitted with approved test card ('1'), order created

checks.precondition: Checkout submitted with Test Payment Gateway card digit '1' (approved).
steps: Submit payment with the approved test card.
Observe the resulting /thank-you page.
checks.observation_point: Confirmation number, heading text, contact/shipping/billing/payment (masked) sections, order summary with cost breakdown.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: page shows a confirmation number, 'Thank you'-style heading, order-confirmed message, contact/shipping/billing/payment (masked card) details, and a cost-breakdown order summary. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug. Only the approved-card path is covered by this check — see CHK-011-ORDER01 for the untested declined/failure paths.

checks.title: Checkout behavior with a non-approved Test Payment Gateway card (declined '2' or gateway-failure '3')

applicability.state: checkout, payment submission with card digit '2' or '3'

checks.precondition: Reach the Payment step of checkout with the Test Payment Gateway.
steps: Submit payment using test card digit '2' (declined).
Separately, submit payment using test card digit '3' (gateway failure).
Observe the resulting page/error state for each.
checks.observation_point: Whether checkout blocks submission, what error message/page is shown, and whether any order record is created.
checks.expected_result: Not established — never observed in this run. Only the approved-card path (CHK-010-ORDER01) has been exercised.
checks.open_question: What is the expected checkout behavior/error message for declined (card '2') and gateway-failure (card '3') test payments? Is any partial/failed order record created on the portal side?

checks.title: Add-to-cart / checkout attempt with one or more required personalization fields left empty

applicability.state: template selected, one or more of the 7 dependent fields left blank

steps: Leave one required field empty (e.g. Woman Name) while filling the rest.
Attempt 'Add to cart'.
Observe whether the action is blocked and what feedback is shown.
checks.observation_point: Whether add-to-cart is blocked; presence/content of a validation message.
checks.expected_result: Not established — this run only observed that these fields are labeled/rendered as required-looking; no actual submit-with-missing-field attempt or validation error was ever triggered or captured (product-kb observed_validations is empty for this feature).
checks.open_question: Is add-to-cart actually blocked when a required personalization field is empty, and if so what validation message is shown? Never observed — 'required' here is only an inferred label, not a tested behavior.

checks.title: Personalization text field behavior at the stated 10-character max length boundary

applicability.state: typing into Woman Name / Cat Name #1 / Cat Name #2 fields

steps: Type exactly 10 characters into a max-10 text field (e.g. Woman Name) and observe the counter/state.
Attempt to type an 11th character and observe whether it is accepted, truncated, or blocked with an error.
checks.observation_point: Field value and counter at exactly 10 characters; behavior on the 11th character.
checks.expected_result: Not established — only 9/10 and 8/10 counter states were observed in this run (i.e. below the boundary). The exact-10 and 11th-character behavior (accept/truncate/block/error) was never exercised. Confidence: LOW / single-sample; do not assume truncation or blocking.
checks.open_question: What happens at exactly 10 characters and on attempting an 11th character in these text fields — is it a hard client-side max-length block, a server-side validation error, or silently unenforced?

checks.title: Complete checkout end-to-end using the Express shipping option

applicability.state: checkout, Express shipping selected instead of Standard

checks.precondition: Cart with 1 personalized item, on checkout page with shipping methods listed.
steps: Select 'Express' shipping instead of 'Standard'.
Complete payment with the approved test card.
Observe the resulting total and order confirmation.
checks.observation_point: Express shipping price actually charged; whether the Express path completes successfully end-to-end.
checks.expected_result: Not established as verified — the $15.00 Express price is INFERRED only (no evidence_ref, no dom snapshot/screenshot), and the Express path was never completed end-to-end in this run.
checks.open_question: Does completing checkout with Express shipping succeed, and what is the actual (evidence-backed) Express price and resulting total?

checks.title: Signed-in buyer can complete the same personalized checkout flow
checks.precondition: A signed-in storefront customer account exists.
steps: Repeat the full personalize -> add to cart -> checkout -> confirmation flow while signed in.
Compare against the GUEST-buyer baseline (CHK-001 through CHK-010-ORDER01).
checks.observation_point: Whether personalization, pricing, cart, and confirmation behave the same for a signed-in buyer as for GUEST.
checks.expected_result: Not established — only the unauthenticated GUEST path was tested in this run; no signed-in buyer path was ever exercised.
checks.open_question: Does the checkout flow behave identically for a signed-in buyer, or are there differences (e.g. saved addresses, different payment options, order attribution)?

checks.title: Cart contents and mockup persist correctly after a page reload

applicability.state: 1 personalized item in cart -> browser reload

steps: Reload the /cart page (or navigate away and back).
Observe whether the line item, price, and mockup thumbnail are unchanged.
checks.observation_point: Cart line item content before vs. after reload.
checks.expected_result: Not established — this run only observed the cart once, immediately after add-to-cart; no reload/persistence check was ever performed.
checks.open_question: Does the cart (including the personalized mockup reference) survive a page reload without data loss or corruption?

checks.title: POST /cart/add request/response contract for a personalized add-to-cart
checks.precondition: Personalization fields filled, about to click 'Add to cart', with network capture enabled.
steps: Capture the raw request and response of the add-to-cart network call.
Verify status code and payload fields (variant_id, quantity, price, customization image reference).
checks.observation_point: Raw HTTP request/response for the add-to-cart call.
checks.expected_result: Not established as verified — this run's KB-006 is knowledge_kind INFERRED, summarized from a browser tool narrative with NO raw request/response body captured (the referenced capture file is missing on disk). It must not be treated as a confirmed API contract.
checks.open_question: What is the true, evidence-backed request/response schema of the add-to-cart call, and does it ever return a non-200 status (e.g. sold-out variant, invalid personalization payload)?

coverage_by_feature_and_risk.risk: Order sync from storefront checkout into the merchant portal is unreliable/unverified as fixed (KB-CONFLICT-001)
Add-to-cart request/response mechanics and Express shipping price are INFERRED, not payload-verified
Pricing/no-surcharge and field-dependency findings rest on 1-2 samples of one template/option combination
No error path (4xx/5xx, declined payment, missing required field) has ever been observed
No signed-in buyer path, no reload/persistence check, no boundary-exact text length check

checks_needing_confirmation.reason: No confirmed SLA for 'reasonable sync time'; KB-CONFLICT-001 root cause unverified.
Missing-required-field submission never observed; 'required' is an inferred label only.
Exact-boundary (10/11 char) text length behavior never observed.
Express shipping price is INFERRED with no evidence_ref; path never completed end-to-end.
POST /cart/add contract is INFERRED, no raw payload captured (capture file missing on disk).

excluded_dimensions.reason: No prior CONFIRMED_EXPECTED baseline or knowledge-diff-analyzer output exists yet for this feature in this zero-doc bootstrap run — there is nothing to diff a behavior change against.

conditions: CHK-006-ORDER01-SYNC must remain phrased as a monitoring/investigation condition tied to KB-CONFLICT-001, never as an assertion that sync is fixed or broken, until orchestrator/context-quality-reviewer resolve the conflict.

CHK-013-ORDER01, CHK-011-ORDER01, CHK-012-ORDER01, CHK-014-ORDER01, CHK-015-ORDER01, CHK-016-ORDER01, CHK-017-ORDER01 remain NEEDS_CONFIRMATION and must not be silently upgraded to READY without an actual observation or PO/Dev confirmation.
Pricing/field-dependency checks (CHK-002-ORDER01, CHK-007-ORDER01) remain scoped to the single tested template/option combination.
